tab-ablation.tex.caption: Consensus extraction and release design on CIFAR-10, $\alpha=0.1$, $T=3$, seed 42. Hard CE gains 5.38 points over soft KL at $\varepsilon=0.1$; full coverage gains 15.02 points over filtering at thresholds 0.4/0.6. Encoding and $K$ test the report interface and semantic resolution.
tab-ablation.tex.note: Reference accuracies are 0.4280 at $\varepsilon=1$ and 0.4202 at $\varepsilon=0.1$, with $K=10$ and no filtering. Accuracy is for the listed variant. Loss and coverage give reference minus variant (design gain); encoding and $K$ give variant minus reference. Values use one seed, with residual noise calibrated to $n=10^4$. Fixed-$K$ choices preserve probability-unit sensitivity; the $K$ sweep changes it.

tab-mia.tex.caption: Audit of fixed round-1 reports under a replace-one adversary knowing all other reports. The strongest client pair attains the sensitivity bound under strong heterogeneity; the corresponding Gaussian test remains close to the random-guess TPR at small budgets.
tab-mia.tex.note: Worst case over all $4950$ client pairs, seed 42, with $T=3$ independent fixed-report releases. Reports are in probability units: $\mu=\lVert R_i-R_j\rVert_2\sqrt{T}/\sigma$. Random guessing has AUC 0.500 and TPR 0.010 at 1\% FPR. $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{GDP}}$ converts $\mu$ to $(\varepsilon,10^{-5})$. Recorded integer-noise replays differ from their corresponding Gaussian TPR by less than 0.001. All seven budgets are displayed.
